natural: And nothing the gateway does is visible on the twenty-sixth. It deploys dark. What ships that evening and what opens on the twenty-seventh are two different events, and only the first one is yours.
plain: Also, nothing the gateway does will be visible on 26 September. It is deployed but switched off. What is installed that evening and what is opened on 27 September are two different events. Only the first one belongs to operations.

natural: Good. I have deployed things at midnight that turned out to be policy decisions. Twice.
plain: Good. Twice in my career I have installed something at midnight and discovered it was really a policy decision.

natural: How does it get validated? Not by us saying it looks right.
plain: How do we check the deployment worked? Not by us saying it looks correct.

natural: One member state's total against last night's reconciled control figure. Match to the cent or the deploy is a failure. And the script picks the member state, because if I fix it to Portugal somebody eventually makes Portugal work.
plain: We compare one member state's total against last night's reconciled control figure. If it does not match exactly, the deployment has failed. The script chooses which member state, because if I always used Portugal, somebody would eventually make Portugal work and nothing else.

natural: And overnight? The load runs at four. If it does not finish, who finds out?
plain: And overnight? The data load runs at 04:00. If it does not finish, who finds out?

natural: Alert before six. Today it pages me and I answer because it is my model. In February it pages a person who has never seen the model and the alert says load incomplete, which is useless.
plain: There is an alert before 06:00. Today it calls me, and I answer, because the data model is mine. In February it will call somebody who has never seen the model, and the alert only says the load is incomplete, which is not useful.

natural: Then that is a work item, not a promise. Rewrite the alert so it names the step and the last good batch, and it goes in the list tonight with Charles's name on it.
plain: Then that is a work item, not a promise. Rewrite the alert so that it names the failed step and the last successful batch. It goes in the Work Items List tonight with Charles's name on it.

natural: There is a worse one and it is not ours. The lending platform takes its maintenance window on the last Wednesday of the quarter. That is the twenty-sixth.
plain: There is a bigger problem, and it is not ours. The lending platform has its maintenance window on the last Wednesday of each quarter. That is 26 September.

natural: Nobody says anything. Babbage puts both hands flat on the desk, which is what he does instead of swearing.
plain: Nobody speaks. Babbage puts both hands flat on the desk. That is what he does instead of swearing.

natural: Then the four o'clock load reads a platform that is halfway through a patch, the replica gets yesterday's positions, and the smoke test fails correctly. Which is the worst kind of failure, because everything worked.
plain: Then the 04:00 load reads a platform that is in the middle of being patched. The replica gets yesterday's positions. The smoke test then fails, and it fails correctly. That is the worst kind of failure, because every part worked as designed.

natural: The platform does not move for us. It is Lending Operations' system of record and it has its own release calendar and its own steering committee, and we are the dependency, not them.
plain: The lending platform will not change its window for us. It is Lending Operations' official system, with its own release calendar and its own steering committee. We depend on it. It does not depend on us.

natural: Then we deploy on the twenty-fifth and hold. Two days dark instead of one. Ada, that is a change to your plan and I would like it written down rather than remembered by the four of us.
plain: Then we deploy on 25 September and wait. The system stays switched off for two days instead of one. Ada, that is a change to your plan. I want it written down, not just remembered by the four of us.

natural: Revision five, tonight, and it goes to your duty manager before it goes to anyone else. She is the only reader who matters. If she cannot run it without ringing Charles, it is not a plan, it is a note.
plain: It will be revision five, written tonight. It goes to your duty manager before anyone else. She is the only reader who matters. If she cannot follow it without telephoning Charles, then it is not a plan. It is a note.

natural: Last thing, and it is the one I actually came for. Eleven national authorities. Accounts, a first-line support route, and somebody who answers a telephone at seven in the morning in a language that is not Luxembourgish. Where is that in your plan?
plain: One last point, and it is the reason I came. There are eleven national authorities. They need accounts, a support route for first contact, and somebody who answers the telephone at 07:00 in a language other than Luxembourgish. Where is that in your plan?

natural: It is not.
plain: It is not in my plan.

natural: And it should not be. Ada's plan puts software on your infrastructure and proves it landed. Training eleven supervisors and standing up a support desk is the Transition Plan and the Business Implementation Plan, which is Grace's side of the house and which exists.
plain: And it should not be. Ada's plan puts software onto your infrastructure and proves it arrived correctly. Training eleven supervisors and setting up a support desk belongs to the Transition Plan and the Business Implementation Plan. That is Grace's side of the organisation, and those documents exist.

natural: Two documents, then. I would rather two documents with owners than one with none. Send me both and I will tell you which of my people is wrong about which.
plain: Two documents, then. I prefer two documents with named owners to one document with no owner. Send me both and I will tell you which of my staff is wrong about which one.

natural: Gustave asked me in January why we were writing a deployment plan for a pipeline that deploys itself. I did not have an answer then. It is this room.
plain: In January, Gustave asked me why we were writing a deployment plan when the pipeline deploys automatically. I had no answer then. The answer is this room.

natural: Sixteen forty. The dry-run ran twice, cleanly, and the second time the duty manager drove it and Babbage sat with his hands in his pockets, which was the point of the afternoon.
plain: It is 16:40. The practice run was done twice, with no problems. The second time the duty manager ran it herself, and Babbage stood with his hands in his pockets. That was the purpose of the afternoon.

natural: Grace has had a Business Implementation Plan since November with eleven supervisors in it by name. Every few months somebody tries to fold it into a technical document, where nobody will read it.
plain: Grace has had a Business Implementation Plan since November, with eleven supervisors named in it. Every few months somebody tries to merge it into a technical document, where nobody will read it.

natural: Then my duty manager opens a fifty-page file at half past nine looking for the configuration order and reads six pages about a training course in Riga. She will stop reading. They always stop reading.
plain: Then my duty manager opens a fifty-page file at 21:30, looking for the order of configuration steps, and finds six pages about a training course in Riga. She will stop reading. People always stop reading.

natural: They know the infrastructure. They do not know that the gateway ships dark, or which of four units can be reversed in ninety seconds, or why the smoke test picks the member state at random. Those are three weeks of our arguments.
plain: They know the infrastructure. They do not know that the gateway is installed switched off, or which of the four units can be reversed in ninety seconds, or why the smoke test chooses the member state at random. Those points come from three weeks of our discussions.

natural: The pipeline has never once decided at twenty-two hundred whether to put ninety minutes of data back. It cannot. That decision has a person's name on it and the name is not in any repository.
plain: The pipeline has never had to decide, at 22:00, whether to spend ninety minutes restoring the data. It cannot make that decision. That decision has a person's name attached to it, and that name is not stored in any repository.

natural: One week to the twenty-seventh. On the wall, three iterations laid end to end: sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, ninety-one points accepted between them, and a release that is the sum of all three and the output of none.
plain: There is one week left before 27 September. On the wall are three iterations side by side: 16, 17 and 18. Together they delivered 91 accepted points. The release is the total of all three. It is not the output of any single one.

natural: The overlay was accepted on the thirty-first of August. The gateway was accepted last Friday. Everything in Release 3 has been demonstrated, accepted and deployed, and none of it is a release yet.
plain: The scenario overlay was accepted on 31 August. The external gateway was accepted last Friday. Everything in Release 3 has been demonstrated, accepted and installed. None of it is a release yet.

natural: Because it is dark. Two-six-three has been in production since Tuesday of last week with the switch down and eleven supervisors who cannot tell it exists.
plain: That is because it is switched off. Work item 263 has been in production since Tuesday of last week, with the switch off. The eleven national supervisors cannot tell that it exists.

natural: Which is the only reason this meeting is calm. The release is the twenty-seventh because that is the day I say a supervisor may look at it. Not the day it shipped.
plain: That is the only reason this meeting is calm. The release date is 27 September because that is the day I say a supervisor may look at it. It is not the day the code was installed.

natural: Then say it in my language. On the twenty-seventh, personal data held by this institution becomes readable by a public authority in another member state. What permits that, in writing, signed, per authority?
plain: Then say it in my terms. On 27 September, personal data held by this institution becomes readable by a public authority in another member state. What permits that? I want it in writing, signed, for each authority.

natural: An administrative arrangement each. Eleven drafted in June, nine signed, two not. Estonia is with their legal service and Cyprus has asked for a change to clause four.
plain: Each authority signs an administrative arrangement. Eleven were drafted in June. Nine are signed and two are not. Estonia's is with their legal service, and Cyprus has asked for a change to clause four.

natural: Then nine.
plain: Then nine authorities, not eleven.

natural: Louis, the code is identical. It costs nothing to open eleven and it costs me a paragraph to explain nine.
plain: Louis, the software is the same for all of them. Opening it to eleven costs nothing. Explaining nine costs me a paragraph.

natural: It costs nothing until March, when somebody asks on what basis Tallinn read a Lithuanian position, and the honest answer is that the switch was one switch. Nine.
plain: It costs nothing until March. Then somebody asks on what basis Tallinn read a Lithuanian position, and the honest answer is that there was only one switch. Nine.

natural: The switch is per authority. It has been per authority since the fifth, because Alan made it a condition in refinement and Hedy built it in a day and a half.
plain: The switch works separately for each authority. It has done since 5 September, because Alan required it during refinement and Hedy built it in a day and a half.

natural: I made it a condition because a single switch is a single mistake. And before anyone turns any of the nine on, I want the row filter proved by somebody who did not write it.
plain: I required it because one switch means one possible mistake. And before anyone turns on any of the nine, I want the row-level filter tested by somebody who did not build it.

natural: And before you say it, I know. Line four of the Definition of Done says the team tested it. I am asking for a different thing, once, for this release only, because this release is the first one where being wrong is not an internal matter.
plain: And before you say it, I know. Line four of the Definition of Done says the team tested it. I am asking for something different, once, for this release only. This is the first release where a mistake would not stay inside the institution.

natural: Security Assurance ran it Monday and Tuesday. Four hundred and twelve queries as a Lithuanian account, none of them mine, none of them Hedy's. Two got more than Lithuania.
plain: The Security Assurance team ran the test on Monday and Tuesday. They made 412 queries using a Lithuanian account. Nobody from our team was involved. Two of those queries returned more than Lithuania.

natural: Hopper stops writing. Brandeis does not look surprised, which is worse than looking surprised.
plain: Hopper stops writing. Brandeis does not look surprised, which is worse than if he did.

natural: Both in the maturity aggregate. Buckets over ten years pooled across the whole book before the filter ran, so the total leaked the shape of Portugal. Fixed Wednesday, retested Thursday morning, four hundred and twelve clean.
plain: Both problems were in the maturity totals. Buckets over ten years were combined across the whole portfolio before the filter was applied, so the total revealed the shape of Portugal's position. It was fixed on Wednesday, retested on Thursday morning, and all 412 queries were then clean.

natural: That is the finding I would have written in October. I would rather have it on a Wednesday. And the amendment record?
plain: That is exactly the finding I would have written in October. I prefer to have it on a Wednesday. And what about the amendment record?

natural: External readers see a role and a date. Loan Operations Officer, eleventh of March. Internal readers see the staff identifier, as before. Two views of one record, and the screening signed on the sixth.
plain: External readers see a role and a date: Loan Operations Officer, 11 March. Internal readers still see the staff identifier, as before. There are two views of one record. The data protection screening was signed on 6 September.

natural: In December of last year I said the feed goes one way and there is no path back into the platform, and that I would quote it at you in 2030. I am early. Nothing on the gateway writes.
plain: In December last year I said that the data feed goes only one way, with no path back into the lending platform, and that I would repeat it to you in 2030. I am early. Nothing on the gateway can write data.

natural: So on the twenty-seventh I have nine authorities, a scenario overlay Risk has wanted since April, and two member states I have to telephone myself.
plain: So on 27 September I have nine authorities, a scenario overlay that Risk has wanted since April, and two member states that I must telephone myself.

natural: Release 3 is delivered on the twenty-seventh. The benefit for two of the eleven is not. Those are different sentences, Grace, and if you merge them upstairs you will be explaining it again in November.
plain: Release 3 is delivered on 27 September. The benefit for two of the eleven authorities is not delivered. Those are two different statements. If you combine them upstairs, Grace, you will have to explain it again in November.

natural: There is training in this too, and it is not code. Eleven half-days, nine of them now, and support cover from seven. That is not iteration 18's work, so I am splitting the team.
plain: There is also training, and that is not software work. Eleven half-day sessions, nine of them now, plus support cover from 07:00. That is not the work of iteration 18, so I am splitting the team.

natural: Gustave and Charles on release work to the twenty-seventh. Hedy and Albert stay on the builder, because December does not move for September. Two halves of one team, one plan, one stand-up.
plain: Gustave and Charles work on the release until 27 September. Hedy and Albert continue on the self-service builder, because the December date does not move for September. Two halves of one team, one plan, one stand-up meeting.

natural: And in January the whole team does that work and nothing else. That iteration is planned like every other one — goal, list, review, retrospective — it just contains no new features.
plain: And in January the whole team does that kind of work and nothing else. That iteration is planned like any other one, with a goal, a list, a review and a retrospective. It simply contains no new features.

natural: Send me the two arrangements when they come back. And do not open Estonia because it is Friday and the switch is right there.
plain: Send me the two arrangements when they are signed. And do not open Estonia just because it is Friday and the switch is easy to reach.

natural: Nobody touches the switch but me, and I do it at nine on the twenty-seventh with Alan in the room. Nine authorities. I will write the two names on the board so we all have to look at them.
plain: Nobody touches the switch except me. I will do it at 09:00 on 27 September, with Alan present. Nine authorities. I will write the two missing names on the board so that we all have to look at them.

natural: She writes them in the corner. Estonia, Cyprus. They stay there until the eighth of November, when one of them comes off, and the board is photographed on the day the other one does.
plain: She writes them in the corner: Estonia, Cyprus. They stay there until 8 November, when one is removed. The board is photographed on the day the second one is removed.

natural: The third-quarter progress report is due on Tuesday. Gantt has the shell of it open and a second window with the CASTOR one from 2027 beside it, for the section numbers, which is how everything in this building gets written.
plain: The progress report for the third quarter is due on Tuesday. Gantt has an empty version of it open, with the CASTOR report from 2027 in a second window, so he can copy the section numbers. That is how everything in this building gets written.

natural: I am not here about the report. I am here because I have been asked to build the closing archive and I have found two sets of logs, and I have never once seen two sets of anything end well.
plain: I am not here about the report. I am here because I have been asked to build the closing archive. I have found two sets of logs, and I have never seen two sets of anything end well.

natural: There is one set.
plain: There is only one set.

natural: There is a risk log in the project space with fourteen entries and a board in your tool with a column called risks that has nine cards in it, four of which are not in the fourteen.
plain: There is a risk log in the project space with fourteen entries. There is also a board in your tool with a column called risks that has nine cards. Four of those cards are not in the fourteen.

natural: Then four of them are still ours and have not moved. A card in that column is a thing the team is watching. When it stops being something we can settle in a fortnight it goes to the fourteen, with a number, and after that it belongs to the project.
plain: Then four of them are still ours and have not moved yet. A card in that column is something the team is watching. When it becomes something we cannot settle within two weeks, it goes into the fourteen, with a number, and after that it belongs to the project.

natural: R-03 was one of them. Charles knows the load model and nobody else does. It sat on their board for two iterations, came across in March, and the mitigation was pairing from iteration five, which is why Hedy can run a reload now.
plain: R-03 was one of those. Charles understands the data load model and nobody else does. It stayed on the team board for two iterations, moved across in March, and the mitigation was pairing from iteration 5. That is why Hedy can now run a reload herself.

natural: And the templates? Because if you have invented an agile risk log I have to describe it in the retention schedule, and I would rather not invent a document class for one project.
plain: And what about the templates? If you have invented a new agile risk log, I must describe it in the retention schedule. I would rather not create a new document class for one project.

natural: They are the CASTOR templates. Unchanged. I checked in January because I expected an argument and did not get one.
plain: They are the CASTOR templates, unchanged. I checked in January because I expected an argument, and there was not one.

natural: Same four. Risk log against the Risk Management Plan, issue log against the issues plan, decision log on its own, change log with the change plan and the request form. What is different is who writes the entries.
plain: The same four logs. The risk log goes with the Risk Management Plan, the issue log with the issues plan, the decision log stands alone, and the change log goes with the change plan and the change request form. What is different is who writes the entries.

natural: Two more than CASTOR had.
plain: You have two logs that CASTOR did not have.

natural: Testing log and retrospectives log. The testing one points at the test plans and the acceptance plan, one entry per release, and Release 2 closed with no reconciliation differences, which I would like read out at my funeral.
plain: Yes: the testing log and the retrospectives log. The testing log refers to the test plans and the deliverables acceptance plan, with one entry per release. Release 2 closed with no reconciliation differences, and I would like that read out at my funeral.

natural: And the retrospectives log points at the Project-End Report. Not at the status report. That column has said so since November and nobody in this project has looked at it.
plain: And the retrospectives log refers to the Project-End Report. It does not refer to the status report. That column has said so since November, and nobody on this project has looked at it.

natural: Eighteen entries in it.
plain: It contains eighteen entries.

natural: Twenty-six in February. Ask me then. Not today, because today you will get the wrong answer and it will be short.
plain: There will be twenty-six by February. Ask me then, not today. Today you would get the wrong answer, and it would be a short one.

natural: Then one thing today. Your board tool is a contract that ends on the thirty-first of March. If any of that lives only there, on the first of April it does not exist and I am the person who will have to write that sentence.
plain: Then one point today. Your board tool is bought under a contract that ends on 31 March. If anything exists only in that tool, then on 1 April it does not exist, and I am the person who will have to write that sentence.

natural: Lovelace writes it on her hand, which she does perhaps four times a year and which everybody in the room has learned to treat as a commitment.
plain: Lovelace writes it on her hand. She does that about four times a year, and everybody here has learned to treat it as a promise.

natural: Back to Tuesday. Overview, then details. Stakeholders, milestones, plan, budget. Three point zero five million of four point six. Four releases, three delivered, twenty-eighth of June and twenty-seventh of September both on the day.
plain: Back to Tuesday's report. First the overview, then the details. Stakeholders, milestones, plan, budget. We have spent 3.05 million euro of 4.6 million. Of four releases, three are delivered. Both 28 June and 27 September were on the planned day.

natural: Scope changes. Two this year and I have written both of them three times, which is once per quarter, which is the whole difference from CASTOR.
plain: Scope changes: there were two this year. I have written about both of them three times, once each quarter. That is the whole difference from CASTOR.

natural: On CASTOR you wrote one of these a year. The scope moved in March and the committee read about it the following February, by which time it was history and nobody could do anything about it except mind.
plain: On CASTOR you wrote one of these reports each year. The scope changed in March and the committee read about it the following February. By then it was history. Nobody could act on it. They could only be annoyed.

natural: They minded a great deal. Achievements, then. Eleven spreadsheets down to two. Nine national authorities live since the twenty-seventh.
plain: They were extremely annoyed. Now, achievements: eleven spreadsheets have been reduced to two, and nine national authorities have had access since 27 September.

natural: And the charter goes with it at version one point three, because Release 3 does not contain what the charter said it contained in October last year, and the committee should read the difference next to the reason.
plain: And the Project Charter goes with the report at version 1.3. Release 3 does not contain what the charter said it would contain in October last year. The committee should read the difference next to the reason for it.

natural: That is the second charter update. The first was July, out of cycle, about the legal basis.
plain: That is the second update to the charter. The first was in July, outside the normal cycle, about the legal basis.

natural: Which came out of a log. Louis raised a question, it went in as a risk with a number, and the Project Manager assigned it to the Architecture Owner in the log rather than in a mail nobody can find.
plain: That came from a log. Louis raised a question. It was entered as a numbered risk. The Project Manager assigned it to the Architecture Owner inside the log, not in an e-mail that nobody can find later.

natural: Then my archive is one shelf and not two. I would like that in writing from all three of you, in a mail, today, because in five years I will be the only one of us still here.
plain: Then my archive is one shelf, not two. I would like that confirmed in writing by all three of you, by e-mail, today. In five years I will be the only one of us still working here.

natural: Seventeen twenty. The report goes out on the Tuesday, eleven pages, and the only sentence anybody quotes back is the one about two spreadsheets.
plain: It is 17:20. The report is sent on the Tuesday. It is eleven pages long. The only sentence anybody quotes back is the one about two spreadsheets.

natural: Half past eight, and on the desk a sheet of paper with an organisation chart on it in pencil, drawn twice. In the second drawing two boxes have gone.
plain: It is 08:30. On the desk is a sheet of paper with an organisation chart drawn in pencil, twice. In the second drawing, two boxes have been removed.

natural: On the first of February this thing runs and I have to say who runs it. Before that, two smaller matters. The committee secretary has proposed that Ada present the development section in December herself, since she writes it.
plain: On 1 February this system goes into service and I must say who operates it. Before that, two smaller matters. The Steering Committee secretary has proposed that Ada present the development section herself in December, since she writes it.

natural: Which I would support. It is one hand-off fewer and she answers questions better than the rest of us because she was there.
plain: I would support that. It removes one hand-off, and she answers questions better than the rest of us, because she was there.

natural: No. She should be in the room and she should answer everything they ask her. The report still comes from me.
plain: No. She should be in the room and she should answer every question they ask. But the report still comes from me.

natural: That is a distinction for the sake of a distinction.
plain: That is a difference that exists only for its own sake.

natural: It is not, and I want it on the record that I am arguing against my own promotion here. My reporting line is to him. It has been since December last year and it is in the handbook.
plain: It is not, and I want it recorded that I am arguing against my own promotion. My reporting line goes to the Project Manager. It has done since December last year and it is written in the handbook.

natural: And the better reason is selfish. The moment I report to that committee, that committee is a stakeholder I am managing. I have one job. It is nine people and a fortnight. I am not good enough to do both and I have watched people try.
plain: And I have a more selfish reason. The moment I report to that committee, the committee becomes a stakeholder that I have to manage. I have one job: nine people and a two-week cycle. I am not able to do both, and I have watched other people try.

natural: Nightingale writes one word on the pencil chart and does not say which.
plain: Nightingale writes one word on the pencil chart. She does not say what it is.

natural: Then the larger matter, and I am going to be rude, and neither of you should take it personally because I am asking it about the roles. Marie has the list. Ada has the team. Grace has the users. In February, what is a Project Manager for?
plain: Then the larger matter. I am going to be blunt, and neither of you should take it personally, because I am asking about the roles. Marie owns the list. Ada runs the team. Grace has the users. So in February, what is a Project Manager for?

natural: Four things, and I lost two of them on purpose. I do not assign work any more. The team plans its own fortnight and I have not opened their board since March except to look at it.
plain: Four things, and I gave up two of them deliberately. I no longer assign work. The team plans its own two weeks. I have not opened their board since March, except to look at it.

natural: And I do not run the ceremonies. I sit in planning and in the review as one voice with no more weight than Charles's. Ada facilitates. On the fifth of April I forgot that for four days and turned the stand-up into a status meeting, and she put me out of it.
plain: And I do not run the ceremonies. I sit in planning and in the review as one voice, with no more weight than Charles has. Ada facilitates them. On 5 April I forgot that for four days and turned the stand-up into a status meeting, and she removed me from it.

natural: I put him out of it on the ninth. On the fifth I said nothing, which was worse.
plain: I removed him on 9 April. On 5 April I said nothing, which was worse.

natural: That is what you gave up. I asked what you do.
plain: That is what you gave up. I asked what you do.

natural: Method, which I share with her. I hold the Project Handbook, she holds the Development Handbook, and neither of us can change the other's without a conversation. That is why Annex D took three days in April and not a committee.
plain: First, method, and I share that with Ada. I hold the Project Handbook and she holds the Development Handbook. Neither of us can change the other's document without a discussion. That is why Annex D was changed in three days in April, instead of going to a committee.

natural: And obstacles. She brings me what the team cannot move. Eleven administrative arrangements. Ada cannot telephone a legal service in Tallinn twice a week for four months. I can, and it is the least agile work on this project and it took Release 3 from seven authorities to nine.
plain: Second, obstacles. Ada brings me what the team cannot move. There were eleven administrative arrangements to sign. Ada cannot telephone a legal service in Tallinn twice a week for four months. I can. It is the least agile work on this project, and it took Release 3 from seven authorities to nine.

natural: And the signatures. Somebody authorises the deployment plan, the work plan, the reports. Ada writes them. She does not approve her own work and I would not let her.
plain: And the approvals. Somebody must authorise the deployment plan, the work plan and the reports. Ada writes them. She does not approve her own work, and I would not allow it.

natural: Where is Marie this morning, incidentally.
plain: Where is Marie this morning, by the way?

natural: Refining, with two analysts and Albert. Half past eight on a Thursday. That is the fourth thing, and it is the one I did not do at all this year. She is the point of contact now. Risk and Finance stopped writing to me in about March.
plain: She is running a refinement session with two analysts and Albert. It is 08:30 on a Thursday. That is the fourth thing, and it is the one I did not do at all this year. Marie is now the permanent point of contact. Risk and Finance stopped writing to me around March.

natural: Then say the rest of it, because you are all being kind and I would rather have the sentence. On this project I have been informed of almost everything and responsible for almost nothing, and Florence has drawn a chart with my box missing.
plain: Then say the rest of it, because you are all being kind and I would prefer the plain sentence. On this project I have been informed of almost everything and responsible for almost nothing. And Florence has drawn a chart with my box missing.

natural: One of the two drawings has your box missing. I drew it to see whether I believed it.
plain: Only one of the two drawings has your box missing. I drew it to see whether I believed it.

natural: In November last year you gave Marie the authority to decide day to day without coming back to you. Twenty-two iterations, and I cannot find a fortnight where this team stopped and waited for a business answer. That is not nothing. That is the whole difference from CASTOR and it does not show up anywhere.
plain: Last November you gave Marie the authority to take daily decisions without returning to you. In twenty-two iterations I cannot find a single one where this team stopped and waited for a business answer. That is not nothing. It is the whole difference from CASTOR, and it appears in no document.

natural: It shows up in April, when I lost.
plain: It appears in April, when I lost the argument.

natural: You lost a ranking. In the same year you ran the user representatives, the eleven training half-days, the support desk, the implementation plan and the benefits measurement, and none of that is Marie's and none of it is mine. Your reach got wider, not narrower.
plain: You lost one ranking decision. In the same year you ran the user representatives, the eleven training half-days, the support desk, the business implementation plan and the benefits measurement. None of that is Marie's work and none of it is mine. Your range got wider, not narrower.
